bagPolicy.summary: Bags are allowed at DC9, but they may be searched for outside drinks.
bagPolicy.quote: Yes we do allow bags. They may be searched for outside beverages.

parking.summary: Parking near DC9 is mostly metered street parking, so read the signs, since some blocks have a residents-only side where you can be ticketed. Nearby garages include the Atlantic Plumbing Building at 2130 8th St NW, the Whole Foods garage at 2210 9th St NW and 850 V St NW Parking.
parking.quote: Some streets have a side that is RESIDENTS ONLY.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by DC9. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Outside drinks aren't allowed at DC9, including water in a personal water bottle.
concessions.quote: We don't allow any outside beverages, including water in a personal water bottle.

accessibility.summary: There is one step up at the front door and 17 steps up to the second-floor concert space. If you need access help, email or text DC9 before your visit.
accessibility.quote: We have one step up at our front door and 17 steps up to our second floor concert, event space.

reEntry.summary: DC9 hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Most DC9 events are all ages, but some have age restrictions, so check your event listing before you go.
ticketPickup.quote: Most of our events are all-ages, but some may have age restrictions.

gates.summary: Each show on the DC9 site lists its own door time and age limit, so check your event before you head out.
